newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Dec palm oil output seen down 15 pct.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Dec palm oil output seen down 15 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil output in December is expected to fall 15 percent to 650,000 tonnes from November, crop forecaster Ivan Wong said on Friday.
Wong forecast end-December palm oil stocks at 860,000 tonnes, compared with the Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority's (PORLA) 955,965 tonnes at end-November.
Exports in December is projected at 625,000 tonnes against PORLA's 632,441 tonnes in November.
"The continuing wet weather throughout the country had delayed harvesting operations in most producing areas," Wong said in a report.
He estimated production for the whole of this year at 8.4 million tonnes, an increase of 7.5 percent or 590,000 tonnes over 1995.
Wong said the expected drop in palm oil stocks reflected the continuing seasonal downtrend in crude palm oil output.
